name: Eliphelet
title: Son of David
summary: Eliphelet was one of King David's sons, born in Jerusalem. He is mentioned in several genealogies in the Old Testament as part of David's royal descendants. The name means 'my God is deliverance' and reflects the theological significance of divine rescue.

keyEvents.title: Born in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Eliphelet was born in Jerusalem as one of David's sons after David had established Jerusalem as his capital.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in David's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Eliphelet is listed among David's sons in the detailed genealogy in 1 Chronicles, confirming his place in the royal lineage.

keyEvents.title: David's Sons in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Eliphelet is mentioned as part of the list of David's sons who were born in Jerusalem, highlighting God's blessing over David's dynasty.

keyEvents.title: David's Royal Inheritance
keyEvents.description: As one of David's many sons, Elifelet was part of the Davidic dynasty that God promised to establish forever through His covenant with David.

keyEvents.title: Two Sons with the Same Name
keyEvents.description: It is remarkable that David had two sons named Elifelet, as shown in the genealogies in Chronicles, where the name appears twice in the list.
